title: Heavenly Father Blesses Job Again
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler whose faithfulness carries him through to joy, and tonight Heavenly Father blesses Job again after his long, hard time: Beau trusts a rainy, canceled playtime will pass, and the next morning the sun comes out over perfect puddles.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because his faithfulness carried him all the way through to joy. In Beau’s world today: Beau was sad when it rained all day and playtime outside was canceled. But he trusted it would pass — and the next morning, the sun came out and the puddles were perfect for splashing! Just like Job trusted Heavenly Father through the hard time and joy came back, Beau learned that after the rain, the sunshine always returns.
